title: Make Ultrasafe Transporter: Toshley's Station
zone: Profession trainer, materials and crafting interface

gaps: Fresh/returning prerequisite coverage is not established as complete.

nodes.text: Open the required profession and its expansion tier. Clear recipe filters, select Ultrasafe Transporter: Toshley's Station and let Toybox read the actual learned recipe. If this character lacks the tier or required skill, follow a supported prerequisite route or choose another activity.

nodes.text: Prepare the recipe’s required materials: 1 Adamantite Frame, 2 Primal Air, 2 Felsteel Stabilizer, 4 Handful of Fel Iron Bolts, 1 Khorium Power Core. These quantities describe one representative quality selection. Use any alternative quality the live recipe accepts; do not add every quality rank together. Reserve each material once across planned crafts. Review missing inputs before spending.

nodes.text: Review the selected recipe, tools and actual reagent slots, then craft Ultrasafe Transporter: Toshley's Station yourself. Crafting uses only the player’s chosen materials and never creates ownership in saved observations.

recovery.text: If the game refuses the craft, read its actual missing tier, skill, specialization, tool or reagent restriction and return to the relevant preparation step. Do not infer craftability from recipe knowledge alone.

nodes.text: Use Ultrasafe Transporter: Toshley's Station from your bags yourself. Wait for the Toy Box to report ownership; crafting and item receipt are separate from learning.

recovery.text: If the item is missing, check inventory, bank and mail. If the game blocks learning, inspect its actual profession or item restriction. The guide does not mark the toy owned from a completed craft.
